title: Elle NDE 4121
content: My entire day leading up until the accident felt strange. I felt another presence surrounding me and almost as though everything had already been planned in advance like it was destined to happen. On my way to the intersection, I felt a strong negative energy and at that moment, I felt as though something terrible was going to happen. I waited patiently at the cross walk for the lights to change and signal my way to cross. Moments later, it was my turn to walk and there were NO vehicles or pedestrians in sight, so I began to cross. Suddenly within seconds, a car was driving at full speed and runs right into me. I could almost feel this negative energy suddenly release and disappear. As for me, I rolled over the entire car, fell onto the street, and felt paralyzed with blood everywhere. I couldn't breathe and I was in a tremendous amount of pain - I tried to lift myself up but I was unable to. I was convinced that I was going to die. I asked God, 'why?' I asked if this is my destiny at least let me die peacefully without additional pain. I began to cry thinking of my family who needed me and how many things I had yet to accomplish such as school, having a family, saying goodbye to loved ones and suddenly my life fast forwarded in front of my eyes and I slowly drifted off. I was now able to see myself laying on the street covered in blood with my belongings scattered around me. I kneeled down beside my body and began to cry, it was far more real this time and I saw two women who had parked there car and ran towards the scene to aid me - but it was too late I was already dead. I looked around and it seemed like another dimension. People who had not been there previously were walking around and doing normal day to day activities. Some had been hurt and some looked normal and suddenly I began to think of how much I still had to do and how I never got the chance to say I love you to my parents and how much I would miss them and felt terrible to know they would find out I died. SUDDENLY a car was driving in the direction of my body lying on the street and my grandfather APPEARED, whom I have never met and only know in photographs, he stood over my body and used his hand to stop the car which was coming in my direction. As he stood there placing his arms out towards the car, it stopped and before I could thank him, I was ALIVE again. I was back in my body for a few moments. Once I had returned to my body the third dimension didn't exist neither did the people I saw and my late grandfather was gone. Paramedics had surrounded me and I remember having the worst headache, which felt like your head being continuously banged into concrete over and over. I drifted off again and went into a different state this time it was a white, pastel light similar to a tunnel. In exactly six and a half hours I woke up in the hospital shivering uncontrollably - alone - and alive with a second chance of life.

environment.environment_other_detail: It "seemed like another dimension" where people were "walking around and doing normal day to day activities."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Pedestrian struck by a car at full speed in an intersection crosswalk.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Also reported a sensed "negative energy" beforehand and seeing an "another dimension" overlay with people doing normal activities.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Accident and distress, brief life fast-forward, OBE viewing body and scene, encounter with deceased grandfather intervening, return to body, later a white/pastel tunnel-like light state, then awakening in hospital.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Drifted off (OBE), returned to body, then drifted off again into a tunnel-like light.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Reported a day-long sense of a surrounding presence and that events were "planned in advance"/destined; perceived "strong negative energy" before impact that "release[d] and disappear[ed]" after being hit; described a "third dimension" that ceased upon returning to the body.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “my life fast forwarded in front of my eyes”; “I was now able to see myself laying on the street covered in blood”; “it seemed like another dimension”; “it was far more real this time”; “I drifted off again and went into a different state this time it was a white, pastel light similar to a tunnel.”
